title: Storey Architecture projects
description: An edge-to-edge two-column photo spread: a tall portrait photo at the left and a landscape one at the top-right, then, after a wide white gap, a small paper note card at the bottom-left and a wide photo at the bottom-right. Each photo is uncovered from black as it enters, drifts slowly inside its frame while scrolling, and shows a small white label that follows the pointer on hover. On phones the three photos stack.
notes: takes three projects (left tall, right top, right bottom); more are ignored
the note card is desktop only
the pointer-following label needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the label shows at the top-left on hover
